jobs.title: B2B Campaign Manager (French) - Contract
jobs.description:
SALT is supporting a global enterprise software business looking for a hands-on Contingent Marketing Manager to support regional marketing and demand generation activity across key European markets.
 ROLE OVERVIEW:
 This is an execution-focused marketing role responsible for delivering regional campaigns, webinars, virtual events and industry events that generate awareness, engagement, leads and pipeline. You'll work closely with Field Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing and external vendors, with approximately 80-90% of the role focused on execution rather than strategic planning. 
 KEY CONTRACT DETAILS:
 - 6+ month contract, Inside IR35
- Remote working, with travel to the Reading office approximately once per month
- £350.00 per day
- French business language capability is essential
 WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Deliver webinars and virtual events end-to-end, including speakers, registration, rehearsals, attendee communications and post-event follow-up.
- Support regional field events, customer roundtables, trade shows and partner programmes, coordinating logistics, vendors and onsite requirements.
- Build and deploy campaign activity across Eloqua, Salesforce, webinar platforms and event management systems.
- Manage campaign assets including emails, landing pages, registration forms and attendee communications while ensuring accurate campaign and CRM data.
- Track registrations, attendance, inquiries, MQLs and pipeline contribution, producing campaign and event performance reporting.
 ABOUT YOU:
 - 3-5+ years' experience across B2B marketing, event marketing or marketing campaign execution.
- Business-level French is essential; German or Italian would be beneficial.
- Demonstrable experience managing webinars and events, ideally within a B2B environment.
- Experience using marketing automation and CRM platforms such as Eloqua and Salesforce.
- Strong experience coordinating multiple campaigns, stakeholders, suppliers and deliverables within tight deadlines; enterprise software/SaaS experience is advantageous.
 *Rates depend on experience and client requirements

 Our client are a leading and renowned global payments platform who are launching a new B2B service and product offering - this role will be responsible for marketing the new product offering across European territories. The role is based in London and will be on an initial day rate contract.

- Lead associated market research programmes, from brief and audience definition through to development of actionable insights and external activation.
- Develop a portfolio of issuer-, and acquirer -ready content and sales-enablement assets, including thought leadership, digital content and compelling UK&I case studies.
- Plan and execute targeted marketing activity to build awareness, create demand and support increased commercial-card acceptance among priority audiences.
- Develop and deliver client engagement programmes, including webinars, roundtables and events, connecting thought leadership and research to commercial conversations.
- Partner with Sales, Product and European/Global Marketing teams to ensure UK&I activity is commercially relevant, scalable and complementary to existing programmes.
- Own programme measurement, budget and agency management, demonstrating marketing impact through agreed engagement, activation and commercial KPIs.
- Drive stakeholder engagement across marketing, sales and product teams, but also with client marketing contacts where relevant

 Profile 
 The successful candidate for the B2B Marketing Lead role: 
 - Will have B2B Marketing experience within a financial services/FinTech/Payments background
- Will be familiar with working within a matrixed environment and how to navigate this
- Strategic and hands on experience across all B2B channels
- The role will cover brand awareness and lead generation programmes.

 This role will be contract on an initial day rate.

jobs.title: Brand and Content Manager
jobs.description:
**About ActAI**

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such as email, notes, tasks and calendar, and they’re not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world who is not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, and enable high-quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Brand & Content Manager to own brand positioning, messaging, content strategy and execution as we bring our AI-native applications to a global audience.

You will define how we communicate our products, build a consistent brand voice and lead content creation across all key channels, working closely with PR, product, design and leadership.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead content creation end-to-end, from planning and writing to editing and publication
* Own brand positioning, target audience strategy, key messaging and tone of voice
* Develop content for websites, social media, product launches, campaigns and executive communications
* Translate complex AI concepts into clear, compelling messages for everyday consumers
* Work closely with PR on media narratives, announcements and external communications
* Maintain brand consistency across channels and optimise content based on performance

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of experience in brand, content marketing or communications, preferably in consumer technology
* Proven experience developing brand positioning, messaging and content strategies
* Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a strong portfolio of published work
* Ability to simplify technical concepts into engaging consumer-facing content
* Strong editorial judgement, creativity and hands-on execution skills
* Genuine interest in AI, consumer applications and emerging technology

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building or launching consumer technology brands
* Experience at an AI company or high-growth startup
* Experience developing content for global audiences

jobs.description:
Alternatively, Grant Thornton
  
  
At Grant Thornton we do things differently - looking to the future, driving ambitious growth and pioneering positive change in our industry. Providing audit, tax and advisory services, we empower clients through strategic insight, curiosity, and genuine partnership. And we empower our people with real opportunity, an inclusive culture and work life balance. A true alternative.
  
  
With over 5,000 people in the UK, and a presence in 150 global markets, we're on an ambitious journey, from great to exceptional, and we need the best people to help us achieve our potential. And with that comes the opportunity to help redefine what our industry looks like, and what you want from your career.
  
  
Job Description:
  
  
**MORE THAN YOU EXPECTED**
Grant Thornton UK LLP is part of a global network of independent audit, tax and advisory firms, made up of some 58,000 people in over 135 countries. We're a team of independent thinkers who put quality, inclusion and integrity first. All around the world we bring a different experience to our clients. A better experience. One that delivers the expertise they need in a way that goes beyond. Personal, proactive, and agile. That's Grant Thornton.
  
  
**NEW GROUND WON’T BREAK ITSELF.**
Every day our teams help people in businesses and communities to do what is right and achieve their goals.
  
  
**A look into the role**
As our Campaigns Lead, you’ll own the campaign engine at the heart of our marketing – turning campaign requests from across the firm into clear, qualified briefs and sequenced plans that our channel teams can deliver. Sitting within Commercial Growth & Strategy and reporting to the Head of Demand Generation, you’ll be the single point of accountability for campaign quality, consistency and pace across our campaign portfolio. As our campaign volume and complexity grow, you’ll make sure campaigns are prioritised against finite capacity rather than run ad hoc, that each one is measured against the commercial impact it was set up to achieve, and that lessons from one campaign shape the next. This is a hybrid role that can be based at any of our UK offices, with travel to London as needed.
  
  
This is a newly formed team, created as part of our marketing transformation. Our campaign framework is in place, and your job is to bring it to life: upskilling the team, making it work in practice and getting everyone working in a consistent way. With the team only just brought together, you’ll have real scope to shape how it works and moves forward, supported by two strong managers already in the team.
  
  
In this role, you’ll:
  
  
  

* Work with go-to-market (GTM) leads to turn business needs into scoped, qualified campaign briefs, with clear objectives, audiences and success measures linked to commercial outcomes
* Own and evolve our campaign framework across always-on, integrated, brand, proposition-launch, segment, account-based marketing (ABM), event and reactive campaigns
* Hold the campaign calendar and, with the Head of Demand Generation, decide how competing campaign requests are prioritised and sequenced
* Partner with Digital Marketing, Channel Marketing and Events, Content, Design and Communications so campaigns are planned and resourced together
* Run governance and quality checkpoints from brief through to campaign close, and lead post-campaign reviews so lessons feed into future campaigns
* Own campaign-level performance reporting, giving GTM leads and sector and service line teams a consistent view of how their campaigns are performing
* Own and develop our AI-assisted campaign briefing tools, and set the standard for responsible use of AI in campaign planning
* Lead and develop the Campaigns team of around eight people, including three managers, setting the standard for how briefs are scoped and campaigns are run

**Knowing you’re right for us**
We’ve set ambitious growth targets for the firm, and we need the right people to help us achieve these. We’re looking for people who will bring ambition and drive to their role. In changing markets, we need to be able to work at pace and be adaptable to change and to be curious, asking questions of ourselves, each other and our clients to ensure we are delivering the services and quality we expect.
  
  
Joining us as Campaigns Lead at Senior Manager level, the minimum criteria you’ll need is proven experience leading a multi-channel campaign function at a senior level, including managing and developing a campaign team.
  
  
It would be great if you had some of the following skills, but don’t worry if you don’t tick every box, we’ll help you develop along the way:
  
  
  

* You’ll have experience within professional services, financial services, another regulated environment or a B2B organisation
* You’ll have a track record of briefing and prioritising competing campaign demand against finite capacity
* You’ll be able to turn an ambiguous business ask into a scoped, qualified brief quickly
* You’ll have strong stakeholder management skills, able to hold the line on priorities with senior leaders while working as a collaborative peer to channel leads
* You’ll bring commercial acumen and a data-driven approach, connecting campaign results back to business outcomes
* You’ll bring a modern approach to campaign planning, beyond traditional marketing, including customer journey mapping, segmentation, and using interest and intent signals to guide campaigns
* You’ll have experience using a content management platform and CRM-based reporting, ideally Microsoft Dynamics
* You’ll be curious about how AI can improve the way campaigns are briefed and planned
* You’ll be a self-starter who takes ownership, sets direction and moves things forward independently, bringing in the right people when you need support

**Knowing we’re right for you**

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Our global Marketing team in London is looking to hire an outstanding Content Marketing Manager who is passionate about storytelling in a corporate environment. You will play a pivotal role in building EF Corporate Learning as a leading global brand in the B2B space and reaching our ambitious revenue growth targets.
  
  
You will be responsible for developing and producing impactful B2B content for our global audience to increase brand awareness and lead generation, collaborating on the overall content strategy and execution, and helping to tell the stories of our clients worldwide to help our sales teams win. This role will report to the Director of Marketing/VP Marketing, and work closely with teams across Marketing, Sales, Design, Product and Academics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, write and edit impactful copy for our international B2B audience including (but not limited to) long-form articles, white papers, case studies, website pages, social posts, blogs, emails, video and podcast scripts.
* Co-design and execute a coherent content strategy and calendar, developing powerful campaigns for brand awareness and lead generation - working closely with the digital marketing team.
* Curate and deliver engaging webinars – from inviting and managing guest speakers, to building slides and scripts, and ensuring successful filming and broadcasting.
* Drive our efforts to build EF Corporate Learning as a leading brand within the B2B space including through custody of our brand guidelines and tone of voice
* Research best practices and keep up to date with latest content trends to develop the most effective themes, formats and channels in order to reach and influence our audience. Use knowledge of SEO to ensure content can be found via search engines.
* Partner with the rest of the Marketing team to coordinate scheduling, translations, measurement of results, and design work as needed.
* Collaborate closely with our internal experts and other thought leaders to bring their expertise, ideas and inspiration to a wide audience through our content.

**The Skills & Experience We Look For**

* The ideal candidate will have 5+ years’ experience of developing, writing and editing high-performing B2B content and can provide insights into what digital content will most engage buyers in large enterprises. Knowledge of the HR/EdTech/Learning space is a plus.
* You should be a highly skilled writer with extensive experience of writing for a B2B audience, with an exciting portfolio to share. Proven ability in video/audio/visual content creation is also advantageous.
* You can work to tight deadlines and have experience optimizing content for email and SEO, as well as analysing performance metrics and improving copy accordingly.
* You are very effective at building relationships, collaborating, and influencing others and dealing with internal and external senior stakeholders. You are comfortable working as a team and leading complex projects cross-functionally in flat organizations.
* You are a self-starter with a creative and strategic mindset, but always detail-oriented – someone who doesn’t shy away from getting things done and delivering high quality work on time.
* You have experience of translating brand identity into engaging content and copy, including developing and adhering to brand tone of voice direction, style guides, and copy libraries.
* You have experience of digital marketing and familiarity with its tech stack – particularly email, social, and Content Management Systems.
* Product marketing experience is a plus – developing the positioning and messaging of B2B products for large enterprises, and creating impactful sales collateral.

**To Thrive At EF, You Will**

* Have strong personal drive and energy
* Possess an entrepreneurial spirit with a nothing is impossible mindset
* Excited by having ownership and autonomy
* Enjoy working in a fast-paced results-driven environment
* Be passionate about learning and languages

**Why work for us?**

* Opportunities to produce meaningful work that makes a difference to people’s lives.
* Developing our talent is core to our values. We provide regular training, access to self-development platforms, real ownership, and career progression opportunities
* An attractive salary (based on track record) and benefits packages
* Comprehensive Onboarding and development programs

**UK Staff Benefits**

* Office gym & yoga studio
* Cycle scheme
* Private Medical Insurance
* Private pension scheme managed by Aviva
* Loan for annual travel passes
* Employee Assistance Programme

**About The Team**
EF Corporate Learning is the world’s first and largest corporate language training provider. Delivering language training for organizations since 1965 and with 20+ million learners trained online since 1996, our legacy and global scale are unmatched. Many of the 3,000+ multinational organizations we serve have partnered with us for over 15 years.
  
  
Our award-winning method is designed using the largest dataset of language learners in the world, drawing from 2.2+ million English assessments, 5+ million live private classes yearly, and countless more learners enjoying structured self-study every day. The result is a learning experience with 3x better engagement and learning progress, helping your teams find their voice, faster.
  
  
EF Corporate Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to inclusion and belonging across race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, disability, parental status, identity, experience and everything else that makes you unique.

We curate a world of beauty that’s ethical, inclusive – and importantly – good fun. We inspire you to live your best life. We are Boden.

  

**Overview**

  

As our business expands globally, we’re growing our International Team to attract more direct-to-consumer (DTC) customers outside the UK and US. The International Marketing Lead will focus on strengthening our presence in Germany and driving growth in newer markets across Europe, Australia and Canada.

  

This position is a new role for Boden, and we are looking for someone who can deepen our presence in established markets, scale those with proven potential, spearhead testing and growth and assess new markets at pace.

  

Working alongside our internal marketing specialists in Acquisition, Retention, Ecommerce, and Analytics, and collaborating with Brand, Product, Finance, and Tech teams, you’ll ensure customers worldwide discover and fall in love with the brand in ways that feel tailored, culturally relevant and uniquely Boden.

  

**Location:** 3 days per week at our North Acton office, 2 days working from home.

**What You Will Do**

  

* Turn customer and market insight into action. Develop a deep understanding of customers, competitors and performance data to shape bespoke marketing and trading plans for each market.

* Lead briefing, localisation processes and local market planning. Give the brand and acquisition teams clear direction on locally relevant activity for each priority market, and keep the localisation roadmap up to date.

* Own the testing roadmap. Identify and unlock opportunities to invest in growth, working with the acquisition team within an agreed economic model. Run locally relevant tests to improve the new customer journey from ad to check-out.

* Recommend which markets to trial next. Work with acquisition, analytics and finance to establish quickly whether a market is worth investing in. Lead performance reviews for each territory and share clear recommendations on where to invest, scale or stop.

* Get hands-on. Build and launch campaigns yourself when speed matters, and create content that feels local, not translated.

* Above all, you’re an excellent relationship builder, able to influence and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, explain ideas clearly, in writing and in person, and bring people with you.

* Prepare spokespeople for challenging interviews and anticipate likely lines of questioning as needed.

* Bring a reputation lens to relevant product, policy and business discussions.

* Balance legal, operational, customer and communications considerations while protecting Preply’s long-term reputation.
